function.name: test_async_generate_to_struct
function.description: 进阶案例:异步生成一个文件并写进当前用户笔记本(struct)的【指定页】。会先用一次【不消费 token】的预检确认 pageid 在授权范围内(越权立刻报错、不白跑后面的耗时活),再后台生成、写入,并把聊天卡片更新为 done / error。需在本块开启 accessStructs(允许新增 block)写权限,否则后端不会下发写 token。

pageid.description: 目标页 id(必填)。用 accessStructs 工具浏览/新建目标页拿到;必须属于被授权的笔记本且落在可写路径内,否则预检直接拒(403)。

content.description: 要写入文件的文本内容

frontend.title: test async generate to notebook page
frontend.tips: a sample amcp: async-generate a file and file it into a CHOSEN notebook page, with a non-consuming pageid precheck (fail-fast) before the expensive work. requires this block's accessStructs write permission.
